maker: University of Toronto (Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, Geoffrey Hinton)
summary: The neural network that won the 2012 ImageNet picture-recognition contest by a wide margin. It showed that deep neural networks trained on graphics chips beat every other method, and it set off the deep learning boom that led to today's AI.

events.note: Entered in the ImageNet contest, which it wins with a top-5 error of 15.3%.
